csv_scope_of_work: This Contract contains requirements for both Design Phase Services and Construction Phase Services. This design build project is at Bruce M. Van Sickle Federal Building & Courthouse in Minot, North Dakota. The Probation Office at the Courthouse needs to make alterations to the office spaces on the third floor to accommodate an increase in staff. The goals are to renovate the existing space and enclose the space from the public corridor.

title: Design-Build for Probation Office Renovation
short_description: Design-build renovation of courthouse probation office space to accommodate increased staff.
project_location: Bruce M. Van Sickle Federal Building & Courthouse, Minot, North Dakota, USA
project_scope: Renovation and alteration of existing probation office spaces on the third floor of the federal courthouse in Minot to accommodate increased staff, including enclosing the office area from the public corridor. The tender covers both design-phase and construction-phase services for refurbishment of existing interior spaces; no gross floor area or further technical dimensions are stated.
services: Design-build services including design phase services and construction phase services for rehabilitation and refurbishment of interior office space.
relevance_explanation:
- Interior renovation of existing office space with no notable structural complexity stated.
- Project is a general building refurbishment, not a bridge, long-span roof, sports venue, or special structure.
- Scope appears focused on architectural/interior alterations rather than innovative structural engineering.
- Limited strategic relevance for sbp despite inclusion of design services.
construction_cost_explanation: No construction cost is stated in the source. Available scope information: third-floor probation office renovation in an existing federal courthouse, including office alterations and enclosure from the public corridor. This suggests a relatively small to medium interior fit-out/refurbishment project, but no realistic USD estimate can be derived reliably from the provided text alone.
fee_explanation: No fee information is stated in the source, and no explicit planning fee basis is provided.
references_qualifications: Design-build/developer capability requested; rehabilitation and refurbishment experience indicated. No specific minimum reference numbers or detailed qualification thresholds are stated in the source.
